  var CONSENT_PURPOSES = ["Advertising","SaleOfInfo"];
  var NINETY_DAYS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 90;

  // FIRST-TOUCH - campaign attribution sticks to the original click.
  // Each row lists accepted aliases; the FIRST name is the stored key.
  // t_source...t_adgroup: SOLVD's aliases. t_s / t_cid / t_crname / t_agid: Google Ads template.
  var FIRST = [
    ['utm_source',   't_source',   't_s'],
    ['utm_medium',   't_medium'],
    ['utm_campaign', 't_campaign', 't_cid'],
    ['utm_term',     't_term',     't_crname'],
    ['utm_content',  't_content'],
    ['utm_adgroup',  't_adgroup',  't_agid']
  ];

  // Mirrors the t_* list in libs/utils/src/picox/utm-params.ts. Salesforce maps them.
  var T_PARAMS = [
    't_s', 't_network', 't_cid', 't_cname', 't_agid', 't_agname',
    't_crid', 't_crname', 't_match_type', 't_device'
  ];

  //   mkc   : campaign matching for webinars/events.
  //   gclid : Google Ads offline conversion import matches on the gclid

  var LAST = [
    ['mkc'],
    ['gclid', 't_gcid']
  ];

  function readCookie(name) {
    var m = document.cookie.match('(^|; )' + name + '=([^;]*)');
    if (!m) { return ''; }
    try { return decodeURIComponent(m[2]); } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

    var host = window.location.hostname;
    return host === 'vimeo.com' || host.slice(-10) === '.vimeo.com' ? ';domain=.vimeo.com' : '';
  }

  function deleteCookie(name) {

        var v = qs.get(k);

    if (next === consented) { return; }
    consented = next;
    if (consented) {
      writeVAttr();
      var cbs = consentCallbacks;
      consentCallbacks = [];
      cbs.forEach(function (cb) { try { cb(); } catch (e) {} });

      clearMarketingCookies();

  window.__onMarketingConsent = onMarketingConsent;

        try { ok = api.isConsented(new Set(CONSENT_PURPOSES)); } catch (e) { ok = false; }

        setConsent(ok);
      }
      check();
      try { api.addEventListener('consent-change', check); } catch (e) {}
    });
  } else {
    writeVAttr();
  }
